data.name: Plots That Span Centuries
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, the next time you would set a scheme in motion, set three schemes in motion instead.
data.flavor_text: "Awaken, cowards! Long have I been preparing for this moment, and you *will* witness my next ascension."

data.name: Power Without Equal
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, draw three cards. You have no maximum hand size until your next turn. If you control six or more lands, you may cast up to three spells from your hand without paying their mana costs.
data.flavor_text: "With what sorry scraps of power do you think to oppose me?"

data.name: A Premonition of Your Demise
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, reveal the top two cards of your library and put them into your hand. When you reveal one or more nonland cards this way, this scheme deals damage equal to their total mana value to any target.
data.flavor_text: "I will unravel you piece by piece."

data.name: Reality Is Mine to Control
data.oracle_text:
(An ongoing scheme remains face up until it's abandoned.)
Whenever you cast a spell, you may abandon this scheme. If you do, copy that spell, and you may choose new targets for the copy. (A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
data.flavor_text: "I will make you a monster to haunt your own dreams."

data.name: Rot Like the Scum You Are
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, create a 2/2 green Ooze creature token, then put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of lands your opponents control.

all_parts.name: Rot Like the Scum You Are

data.flavor_text: "Defy me, and you will dissolve inch by screaming inch."

data.name: Running Is Useless
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, choose any number of creatures with different mana values. Destroy those creatures.
data.flavor_text: "Yes, flee from me, prey! Flee from your inevitable fate until your feeble mortal body collapses. I will drink my fill of your fear."

data.name: Time Bends to My Will
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, take an extra turn after this one. Skip the untap step of that turn.
data.flavor_text: "I can stretch a single moment of agony into centuries."

data.name: When Will You Learn?
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, each opponent exiles the top card of their library. You may cast any number of spells from among cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
data.flavor_text: "Do you not grow tired of your futility? I know I do."

data.name: You Are Unworthy of Mercy
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, each opponent sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice. If you control six or more lands, each opponent sacrifices three nonland permanents of their choice instead.
data.flavor_text: "When you die alone, know that it was I who took everything from you."

data.name: You Cannot Hide from Me
data.oracle_text:
(An ongoing scheme remains face up until it's abandoned.)
At the beginning of combat on your turn, up to one target creature gets +2/+2 and gains vigilance until end of turn. It can't be blocked this turn.
At the beginning of each opponent's end step, if that player has less than half their starting life total, abandon this scheme.

data.name: You Exist Only to Amuse
data.oracle_text:
When you set this scheme in motion, choose one. If you control six or more lands, choose both instead.
• Create three 1/1 red Devil creature tokens with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
• Until your next turn, creatures your opponents control have base power and toughness 1/1 and lose all abilities.

data.name: You Live Only Because I Will It
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, you may redistribute any number of life totals. (Each affected player or team gets one of those life totals back.)

data.name: You Will Know True Suffering
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, it deals damage equal to your commander's mana value to each noncommander creature your opponents control.
data.flavor_text: "Know that the pain you feel now is but an infinitesimal fraction of the agony I will soon inflict upon you."

data.name: Your Mistake Is My Triumph
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, each player mills three cards. Then you put a permanent card from among the milled cards onto the battlefield under your control.
data.flavor_text: "Know, as you perish, that all it took was a single misstep for you to fall into my clutches."

data.name: Your Nightmares Are Delicious
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, each opponent who has more than five cards in hand discards cards equal to the difference. Then if fewer than three cards were discarded this way, you draw three cards.
data.flavor_text: "I will craft exquisite tortures from the roiling depths of your terrified mind."

data.name: Your Own Face Mocks You
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, choose up to two target creatures your opponents control. For each one, create a token that's a copy of it. If you created fewer than two tokens this way, create a number of 4/4 colorless Scarecrow artifact creature tokens with vigilance equal to the difference.

data.name: Your Plans Mean Nothing
data.oracle_text: When you set this scheme in motion, any number of target players each discard their hands. Each opponent draws cards equal to the number of cards that player discarded minus one. Then if you discarded a card this way, draw seven cards.
data.flavor_text: "You will crawl through the ashes of your own grand ambitions before I grant you the mercy of death."

data.name: Crypt Ghast
data.oracle_text:
Extort (Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {W/B}. If you do, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain that much life.)
Whenever you tap a Swamp for mana, add an additional {B}.
data.flavor_text: The soul of a murderer from the old world, steeped for centuries in rot and malevolence.

data.name: Damn
data.oracle_text:
Destroy target creature. A creature destroyed this way can't be regenerated.
Overload {2}{W}{W} (You may cast this spell for its overload cost. If you do, change "target" in its text to "each.")
data.flavor_text: As their bodies crumbled to ash, the cultists' terrible smiles only grew wider.

data.name: Exhume
data.oracle_text: Each player puts a creature card from their graveyard onto the battlefield.
data.flavor_text: Those who try to rob a grave claimed by a necromancer rarely make the same mistake twice.

data.name: Archon of Cruelty
data.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this creature enters or attacks, target opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice, discards a card, and loses 3 life. You draw a card and gain 3 life.

data.name: Goryo's Vengeance
data.oracle_text:
Return target legendary creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
Splice onto Arcane {2}{B} (As you cast an Arcane spell, you may reveal this card from your hand and pay its splice cost. If you do, add this card's effects to that spell.)

data.name: Living Death
data.oracle_text: Each player exiles all creature cards from their graveyard, then sacrifices all creatures they control, then puts all cards they exiled this way onto the battlefield.
